title: Swedish Krona: Riksbank hawkish hold backs currency – BBH
summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports the Swedish Krona (SEK) rallied after the Riksbank delivered a hawkish hold, keeping rates unchanged but signaling more tightening ahead.

title: Canada: Retail Sales Contact in July While August Points to a Rebound.
summary: Retail sales declined 0.7% month-on-month (m/m) in July, a notch above Statistics Canada’s advance estimate. In volume terms, retail sales fell by a stronger 1.1% m/m, pointing to somewhat weaker underlying demand. title: Dollar Surges as Fed Hike Bets, Oil Chokepoint Risk and China Trade Uncertainty Converge
summary: Dollar strengthened against every major currency Thursday as three drivers moved together: October Fed hike odds surged to 77.5%, from roughly 53% a day earlier and under 10% a month ago, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield to around 5.14%, its highest since 2007; Brent extended its rally above $105 as Houthi forces advanced toward the Bab el-Mandeb corridor, opening a second oil chokepoint alongside Hormuz; and the US and China extended their trade truce by only two months, to January 10, rather than locking in a more durable reset. title: US Jobless Claims Slip to 197k as Layoffs Remain Subdued
summary: US initial jobless claims edged down from a revised 198k to 197k in the week ending September 19, slightly below expectations of 200k. The prior week was revised up from 196k, but the four-week moving average still declined from 204.0k to 202.25k, pointing to a broadly stable and relatively low level of layoffs.
